standardized.notes: RFC 1583 publication; earlier OSPF RFC 1131 and RFC 1247 are distinct revisions.

roles: distribute link-state topology within an autonomous system
addressing: IPv4-focused OSPFv2 generation; route and area semantics depend on the exact RFC revision.
routing_or_forwarding: Link-state/SPF IGP; RFC 1583 explicitly contrasts this with traditional Bellman-Ford-based TCP/IP routing protocols.

operations.monitoring: Adjacency state, LSDB contents, areas, LSAs and SPF results are central operational state.
operations.diagnostics: Neighbor formation, flooding, database synchronization and route calculation are core diagnostic domains.
operations.failure_behavior: Topology changes trigger LSA flooding and SPF recomputation; detailed timers and behaviors are revision-specific.

survival.provenance_notes: OSPF remains widely deployed; this record represents the RFC 1583 historical generation.

open_questions: Create artifacts for RFC 1131 and RFC 1247 generations and formal revision edges.
Recover earliest OSPF implementations and Working Group design notes.
Trace vendor/daemon implementation genealogy separately from wire specification.

related_artifacts.notes: RIP shares the IGP role but belongs to a distance-vector/Bellman-Ford family.
Integrated IS-IS is a parallel link-state IGP with OSI standards ancestry.

notes: OSPF should not be represented as a formal revision of RIP; the role overlaps while the algorithmic and standards genealogies differ.
